annotations.title: Reply to a comment or review

description: Post a live public reply to a comment or Google Business Profile review from inbox_list (Studio and Pro). Pass text directly, or pass templateId from inbox_replies_list to fill {name} automatically. Always show the exact reply wording and which comment or review it answers, and wait for the user’s explicit yes before calling this tool.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: The inbox item id from inbox_list.

templateId.description: Optional saved reply id from inbox_replies_list. When text is left out, fills {name} with the author’s first name; when text is also given, sends text and records saved-reply usage.

text.description: The exact reply message to post publicly (1 to 2000 characters; Bluesky replies allow at most 300 characters). Required unless templateId is given. Show this wording to the user and get their yes first.

name: inbox_reply
title: Reply to a comment or review
